module_objectives: Compare custom demo, Glean Lab, sandbox and pilot on data, prep, duration and cost.

Apply the pilot entry criteria and readiness scorecard.

Given the supplied customer-neutral scenario and sources, assess a pilot request with no sponsor, no baseline and no scoped use case. Successful output matches the worked response and states remaining uncertainty.
